title: Scale Desk and Pickup Locker Hall
description: One static postal service and pickup hall scene, zero new models. A complete open worktable on the left carries the original whole tabletop parcel scale at its documented unit-scale table height. A separate complete four-compartment pickup locker sits to the right and rear, preserving all four original doors, its one fixed-open lower door, eight real bored hinge pairs and all original hardware. A closed scene-only floor and central approach band distinguish the counter-side preparation position from the independent locker-front zone. Three complete old models preserve raw mesh/normal payloads, internal transforms, original fixed poses and every per-face PBR. The broad front approach and gap between the complete desk and locker are unoccupied. Different from the mailbox/cubby street corner and the table-to-rear-cubby sorting room; no copied scene relabelled as a hall. No parcels, credentials, readable display, weighing, transactions, collection service, locks or security, door movement, capacity, ergonomic or accessibility compliance, installation or public-safety certification is claimed.
